source: Dense retrieval also does not make lexical retrieval obsolete. E5’s analysis explicitly noted cases where BM25 retained advantages, especially for exact lexical matching and certain long-tail or long-document tasks. [14]
zh: 密集检索也不会使词汇检索过时。 E5 的分析明确指出了 BM25 保留优势的情况，特别是在精确词汇匹配和某些长尾或长文档任务方面。 [14]
